scope: Actual Tavily call; no private CSV or product identifiers in query. Decision routing is conservative and needs human policy-fidelity review.

packet.query: Shopify official documentation manual POS draft order discounts bypass combination settings exceptions

sources.title: Shopify Help Center | Discount combinations on POS
sources.snippet: Custom discounts that you apply manually in Shopify POS always apply to the order, even if other discounts have combination restrictions. You can't apply custom line item discounts to a split line item. After you apply a custom line item discount in Shopify POS, additional product discount codes can't be applied to that same item. decision.disprove: The original promotion record, store eligibility, applicable policy effective date, and a controlled test could disprove this hypothesis.
decision.constraint: The policy passage describes an exception to combination settings for this seller-provided discount origin. A settings toggle is not established as a remedy.
decision.nextCheck: Audit staff/manual POS and draft-order overrides, permissions, and promotion intent before changing combination settings.
